 python-debian (0.1.49ubuntu2) lunar; urgency=medium

diff --git a/debian/patches/lp2171509-Handle-non-UTF-8-data-from-gpgv-signature-checking.patch b/debian/patches/lp2171509-Handle-non-UTF-8-data-from-gpgv-signature-checking.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8fffb24
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/lp2171509-Handle-non-UTF-8-data-from-gpgv-signature-checking.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+From 81e40b03fa63bc6b4d5aebece0e295468818ba45 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: Stuart Prescott <stuart@debian.org>
+Date: Sun, 9 Mar 2025 23:58:54 +1100
+Subject: [PATCH] Handle non-UTF-8 data from gpgv signature checking
+
+With thanks to Gianfranco Costamagna for the suggested fix.
+
+Closes: #1095835, #1087991
+
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+bug/2171509
+Origin: upstream, https://salsa.debian.org/python-debian-team/python-debian/-/commit/01d2f7c2d4a77731aa640b710ae1002cf20da280
+---
+ lib/debian/deb822.py | 4 ++--
+ 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
+
+diff --git a/lib/debian/deb822.py b/lib/debian/deb822.py
+index 7a0f890..c322fb5 100644
+--- a/lib/debian/deb822.py
++++ b/lib/debian/deb822.py
+@@ -1371,8 +1371,8 @@ class GpgInfo(_BaseGpgInfo):
+                 inp = cls._get_full_bytes(sequence)
+             out, err = p.communicate(inp)
+ 
+-        return cls.from_output(out.decode('utf-8'),
+-                               err.decode('utf-8'))
++        return cls.from_output(out.decode('unicode-escape'),
++                               err.decode('unicode-escape'))
+ 
+     @staticmethod
+     def _get_full_bytes(sequence):
+-- 
+2.43.0
+
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..73dec91
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+lp2171509-Handle-non-UTF-8-data-from-gpgv-signature-checking.patch
diff --git a/lib/debian/deb822.py b/lib/debian/deb822.py
index 7a0f890..c322fb5 100644
--- a/lib/debian/deb822.py
+++ b/lib/debian/deb822.py
@@ -1371,8 +1371,8 @@ class GpgInfo(_BaseGpgInfo):
                 inp = cls._get_full_bytes(sequence)
             out, err = p.communicate(inp)
 
-        return cls.from_output(out.decode('utf-8'),
-                               err.decode('utf-8'))
+        return cls.from_output(out.decode('unicode-escape'),
+                               err.decode('unicode-escape'))
 
     @staticmethod
     def _get_full_bytes(sequence):
